::: {#def-data-augmentation}

#### Data augmentation

**Data augmentation** trains on transformed copies of the training inputs,
made by transformations that should not change the target
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 7.4].
Usually a new random transformation is drawn for each input at each [epoch](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch).

:::
